Ví dụ minh họa: 料理が嫌いなわけではないが、毎日作る時間がない。 (It's not that I dislike cooking, but I don't have time to cook every day.) | 値段が高ければおいしいというわけではない。 (Just because something is expensive doesn't mean it tastes good.) | 全然分からないわけではありませんが、もう少しゆっくり話していただけますか。 (It's not that I don't understand at all, but could you speak a little more slowly?) [Ghi chú: A partial or soft denial of what the listener might assume. Often with いつも, 全部 or 必ずしも. Not the same as 〜わけがない, which flatly rules something out.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: there's no way that; cannot possibly
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わけがない
Ví dụ minh họa: こんなに練習したんだから、負けるわけがない。 (We've practiced this hard, so there's no way we'll lose.) | あんなにまじめな人が、約束を忘れるわけがありません。 (There's no way someone that conscientious would forget a promise.) | 一日で漢字を百個覚えるなんて、できるわけがないよ。 (Learn a hundred kanji in one day? There's no way you can do that.) [Ghi chú: The speaker's strong conviction that something is impossible. Casual: 〜わけない. Close to 〜はずがない, but sounds more emotional and less based on reasoning.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: can't afford to; can't very well; must not (for social or moral reasons)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + わけにはいかない
Ví dụ minh họa: 明日は大事な会議があるから、休むわけにはいかない。 (There's an important meeting tomorrow, so I can't afford to take the day off.) | 友達に頼まれたことだから、断るわけにはいかなかった。 (It was a favor my friend had asked, so I couldn't very well say no.) | 招待されたのだから、パーティーに行かないわけにはいかない。 (I was invited, so I can't not go to the party.) [Ghi chú: The action is physically possible but ruled out by duty, circumstances or common sense. 〜ないわけにはいかない means 'have to; can't avoid doing'.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: it's natural that; one should; used to (nostalgia); how ...! (deep feeling)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものだ
Ví dụ minh họa: 子どものころは、この川でよく泳いだものだ。 (When I was a child, I used to swim in this river a lot.) | 新しい環境に慣れるには、時間がかかるものだ。 (It naturally takes time to get used to a new environment.) | 目上の人には敬語を使うものだ。 (You're supposed to use honorific language with your superiors.) [Ghi chú: Main uses: general truth or natural tendency, a social norm (should), a nostalgic past habit with 〜たものだ, and deep feeling (時間がたつのは早いものだ). Casual: 〜もんだ.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: one shouldn't; it's not right to
Ví dụ minh họa: 人の失敗を笑うものではない。 (You shouldn't laugh at other people's mistakes.) | 出された食べ物を残すものじゃないよ。 (You shouldn't leave food that's been served to you.) | 夜遅くに人の家に電話をかけるものではありません。 (One shouldn't phone someone's home late at night.) [Ghi chú: Advice based on common sense or social norms, often from an older person. Casual: 〜もんじゃない. Sounds more like general wisdom than 〜べきではない.]

「どうして食べないの？」「だって、ピーマン嫌いなんだもん。」 ('Why aren't you eating?' 'Because I hate green peppers!') | 一人で行けるよ。もう子どもじゃないもん。 (I can go by myself. I'm not a kid anymore!) | ケーキ、全部食べちゃった。だって、すごくおいしかったんだもん。 (I ate the whole cake. Well, it was just so good!) [Ghi chú: Sounds pouty or self-justifying; often begins with だって. もん is more colloquial. Used by children and among close friends; avoid at work.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: because; since (explaining or excusing a situation)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + な + ものだから / もので
Ví dụ minh họa: 道がすごく混んでいたものだから、約束の時間に間に合わなかった。 (The roads were really crowded, so I couldn't make it on time.) | すみません、急いでいたもので、書類を持ってくるのを忘れてしまいました。 (I'm sorry, I was in such a hurry that I forgot to bring the documents.) | 初めての海外旅行だったものだから、見るものすべてが珍しかった。 (It was my first trip abroad, so everything I saw seemed new.) [Ghi chú: Explains or excuses something that wasn't fully under the speaker's control. The main clause can't be a command or request. もので is common in polite apologies.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: should; the best thing is to (advice)
Ví dụ minh họa: 日本語が上手になりたいなら、毎日少しずつでも話すことだ。 (If you want to get good at Japanese, you should speak it every day, even just a little.) | 風邪を早く治したければ、無理をしないでゆっくり休むことです。 (If you want to get over your cold quickly, the best thing is not to push yourself and to rest well.) | 人の話は最後までよく聞くことだ。 (You should always listen carefully to what people say, right to the end.) [Ghi chú: Personal advice from someone in a position to give it (teacher, parent, senior). Not used toward superiors. Compare 〜ものだ, which appeals to general norms.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: there's no need to; don't have to
Ví dụ minh họa: 簡単な手術ですから、そんなに心配することはありませんよ。 (It's a simple operation, so there's no need to worry so much.) | 駅までは歩いて五分だから、タクシーを使うことはない。 (The station is a five-minute walk, so there's no need to take a taxi.) | 一回失敗したくらいで、あきらめることはないよ。 (There's no need to give up just because you failed once.) [Ghi chú: Reassures or advises that something is unnecessary. Don't confuse with 〜たことはない ('have never done').]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: make it a rule to; make a point of
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことにしている
Ví dụ minh họa: 健康のために、週に三回はジムに通うことにしている。 (For my health, I make it a rule to go to the gym at least three times a week.) | 夜十時以降は、スマホを見ないことにしています。 (I make a point of not looking at my phone after 10 p.m.) | 父は、給料日には家族を外食に連れていくことにしている。 (My dad makes a point of taking the family out to eat on payday.) [Ghi chú: A personal rule the speaker (or subject) decided on and keeps. Compare 〜ことになっている, a rule or plan set by others.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: it has been arranged that; it's the rule that; be supposed to
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことになっている
Ví dụ minh họa: この寮では、夜十一時までに戻ることになっている。 (In this dorm, you're supposed to be back by 11 p.m.) | 来月から大阪の支社で働くことになっています。 (It's been arranged that I'll work at the Osaka branch from next month.) | 図書館の中では、飲み物を飲んではいけないことになっている。 (The rules say you can't have drinks inside the library.) [Ghi chú: Rules, customs or plans decided by others (a company, school, society), not a personal choice. Compare 〜ことにしている.]

レポートは、来週の金曜日までに提出すること。 (Reports must be submitted by next Friday.) | 図書館の本に、線を引かないこと。 (Do not draw lines in library books.) | 試験中は、スマホの電源を切っておくこと。 (Keep your phone switched off during the exam.) [Ghi chú: Ends a sentence with こと to state a rule. Found in notices, regulations and teacher-to-student instructions. Impersonal; not used toward superiors.]

Cách đọc (Furigana / On-Kun): you ni iu / you ni tanomu
Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: tell someone to do; ask someone to do (reported command or request)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ように言う / ように頼む
Ví dụ minh họa: 医者に、お酒を飲みすぎないように言われた。 (My doctor told me not to drink too much.) | 隣の部屋の人に、夜は音楽の音を小さくするように頼んだ。 (I asked the person next door to turn their music down at night.) | 山下さんに、明日の会議に遅れないように伝えてください。 (Please tell Ms. Yamashita not to be late for tomorrow's meeting.) [Ghi chú: Reports an instruction or request indirectly. Works with other verbs too: 伝える, 注意する, お願いする. Direct-quote version: 「〜てください」と言う.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: try to; attempt to; be about to
Ví dụ minh họa: ドアを開けようとしたが、鍵がかかっていて開かなかった。 (I tried to open the door, but it was locked and wouldn't open.) | 家を出ようとしたとき、急に雨が降り出した。 (Just as I was about to leave the house, it suddenly started to rain.) | 弟は何度注意しても、部屋を片付けようとしない。 (No matter how many times I tell him, my younger brother won't even try to tidy his room.) [Ghi chú: Often an attempt that fails or is interrupted. 〜ようとしない = 'won't even try' (unwillingness). Compare 〜てみる, which means actually doing something to see how it goes.]

Cách đọc (Furigana / On-Kun): sou ni nai / sou mo nai
Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: unlikely to; doesn't look like it will
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-stem + そうにない / そうもない
Ví dụ minh họa: この雨は、夕方までやみそうにない。 (This rain doesn't look like it will stop before evening.) | 仕事が多すぎて、今日中には終わりそうもない。 (I have way too much work; it doesn't look like I'll finish today.) | こんなにたくさんの料理、二人では食べきれそうにないね。 (It doesn't look like the two of us will be able to finish all this food.) [Ghi chú: Negative of the appearance 〜そうだ with verbs, based on what the speaker observes. More emphatic: 〜そうにもない. With adjectives use 〜なさそうだ instead.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: keep on -ing; more and more (change in one direction)
Ví dụ minh họa: この町の人口は、減る一方だ。 (This town's population just keeps on shrinking.) | 物価は上がる一方なのに、給料は全然上がらない。 (Prices keep going up and up, yet my salary doesn't rise at all.) | 勉強をさぼっていたら、成績は下がる一方だった。 (Since I kept skipping my studies, my grades just kept dropping.) [Ghi chú: Steady change in one direction, usually (not always) for the worse. Used with verbs of change such as 増える, 減る, 上がる, 悪くなる.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: while; on the other hand; at the same time
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + である + 一方で
Ví dụ minh họa: インターネットは便利な一方で、危険な面もある。 (The internet is convenient, but on the other hand it has its dangers.) | この会社は給料が高い一方で、休みがとても少ない。 (This company pays well, but on the other hand there are very few days off.) | 彼女は会社で働く一方で、夜は大学院に通っている。 (While working at a company, she also attends graduate school in the evenings.) [Ghi chú: Presents two sides of one thing, or two parallel activities. Compare 〜に対して, which contrasts two different subjects.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + に対して / Noun + に対する + Noun / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + のに対して
Ví dụ minh họa: お客様に対して、そんな言い方をしてはいけない。 (You mustn't speak like that to a customer.) | 新しい税金に対する反対の声が高まっている。 (Opposition to the new tax is growing.) | 東京は晴れているのに対して、大阪は朝から大雨だ。 (Whereas it's sunny in Tokyo, it's been pouring in Osaka since morning.) [Ghi chú: Marks the target of an action, attitude or feeling, or contrasts two things. Compare 〜について, which marks the topic being discussed rather than a target.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + について / Noun + についての + Noun
Ví dụ minh họa: 今日の授業では、日本の食文化について話し合いました。 (In today's class, we discussed Japanese food culture.) | 新しい商品についての質問は、こちらのメールアドレスまでお送りください。 (Please send any questions about the new product to this email address.) | その事件について、警察はまだ何も発表していない。 (The police haven't announced anything about the incident yet.) [Ghi chú: Marks the topic of speaking, thinking or research. More formal: 〜に関して. Compare 〜に対して (the target of an attitude or action).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: by (agent); by means of; due to; depending on
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + によって / Noun + による + Noun
Ví dụ minh họa: この橋は、有名な建築家によって設計された。 (This bridge was designed by a famous architect.) | 台風による被害は、まだ正確には分かっていない。 (The full extent of the damage caused by the typhoon is still unknown.) | 国によって、食事のマナーはずいぶん違う。 (Table manners differ quite a lot from country to country.) [Ghi chú: Uses: agent of a passive (formal, for creating or discovering), cause, means, and 'varies by'. 〜によっては = 'in some cases, depending on'.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + によると / Noun + によれば
Ví dụ minh họa: 天気予報によると、週末は大雪になるそうだ。 (According to the weather forecast, there's going to be heavy snow this weekend.) | ニュースによれば、事故の原因はまだ分かっていないらしい。 (According to the news, the cause of the accident still isn't known.) | 姉の話によると、あのレストランは予約がないと入れないということだ。 (According to my sister, you can't get into that restaurant without a reservation.) [Ghi chú: Names the source of information. The sentence usually ends in a hearsay expression such as 〜そうだ, 〜らしい or 〜ということだ.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ばかりでなく
Ví dụ minh họa: この映画は子どもばかりでなく、大人も楽しめる。 (Not only children but adults too can enjoy this film.) | 新しいスマホは画面が大きいばかりでなく、電池も長持ちする。 (The new smartphone not only has a big screen, its battery lasts a long time too.) | 運動は体にいいばかりでなく、ストレスを減らす効果もある。 (Exercise is not only good for your body, it also helps reduce stress.) [Ghi chú: Same meaning as 〜だけでなく but a little more formal. The second part usually contains も or まで.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけでなく
Ví dụ minh họa: この店は料理がおいしいだけでなく、値段も安い。 (This restaurant not only has delicious food, it's cheap too.) | 地震の後、水だけでなく電気も止まってしまった。 (After the earthquake, not only the water but also the electricity was cut off.) | 彼女は歌が上手なだけでなく、自分で曲も作っている。 (She not only sings well but also writes her own songs.) [Ghi chú: Common in both speech and writing. Casual: 〜だけじゃなくて. Slightly less formal than 〜ばかりでなく.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: both ... and ...; not only ... but also
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + も + Verb-ba + Noun + も / Noun + も + i-Adj stem + ければ + Noun + も
Ví dụ minh họa: 彼女は歌も歌えば、ピアノも弾く。 (She both sings and plays the piano.) | この町には、海もあれば山もある。 (This town has both the sea and the mountains.) | 人生には、いいときもあれば悪いときもある。 (In life there are good times and there are bad times.) [Ghi chú: Lists two facts of the same kind for emphasis; contrasting pairs (いいときも悪いときも) are very common. Compare 〜し, which lists reasons.]

今日は春らしい暖かい一日だった。 (Today was a warm, truly spring-like day.) | 文句ばかり言うなんて、君らしくないね。 (Complaining all the time isn't like you.) | もっと学生らしい服装で来てください。 (Please come dressed in a way more appropriate for a student.) [Ghi chú: Having the qualities you expect of the noun. Negative: 〜らしくない ('not like'). Differs from the hearsay 〜らしい (N4) and from 〜っぽい (looks like X but isn't).]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun / Verb-stem / i-Adj stem + っぽい
Ví dụ minh họa: この服はちょっと子どもっぽいから、別のにしよう。 (This outfit is a bit childish, so let's go with a different one.) | 最近忘れっぽくなって、困っている。 (I've become forgetful lately, and it's a problem.) | あの白っぽいビルが、新しい市役所です。 (That whitish building is the new city hall.) [Ghi chú: Noun + っぽい: seems like X though it isn't (大人っぽい). Verb-stem + っぽい: tends to (怒りっぽい). Compare 〜らしい, which means truly typical of X.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + 的な + Noun / Noun + 的に
Ví dụ minh họa: 日本の伝統的な料理を食べてみたい。 (I'd like to try traditional Japanese food.) | この問題は、経済的な理由で解決が難しい。 (This problem is hard to solve for economic reasons.) | 個人的には、この案に賛成です。 (Personally, I'm in favor of this plan.) [Ghi chú: Turns a (usually kanji) noun into a na-adjective: 的な before nouns, 的に before verbs and adjectives. Many are best learned as words: 具体的, 基本的, 積極的.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / Noun + の + ような / ように
Ví dụ minh họa: 私も、あなたのような優しい看護師になりたいです。 (I want to become a kind nurse like you, too.) | 先生が言ったように、この文法はテストによく出る。 (As the teacher said, this grammar point often comes up on tests.) | 東京のような大きな都市では、家賃がとても高い。 (In big cities such as Tokyo, rent is very high.) [Ghi chú: ような comes before nouns, ように before verbs and adjectives. AのようなB can also mean 'B such as A'. Casual: 〜みたいな / 〜みたいに.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: まるで + Verb-plain / Noun + の + ようだ
Ví dụ minh họa: この部屋は広くて明るくて、まるでホテルのようだ。 (This room is so big and bright, it's just like a hotel.) | 久しぶりに会った友達は、まるで別人のように変わっていた。 (My friend, whom I hadn't seen in ages, had changed so much she seemed like a different person.) | 三月なのに、今日はまるで真夏のように暑い。 (It's only March, but today it's as hot as midsummer.) [Ghi chú: まるで signals a figurative comparison: it only seems so. Casual: まるで〜みたいだ. Compare N2 〜かのようだ.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に違いない
Ví dụ minh họa: 隣の家は何日も電気が消えている。家族で旅行に出かけたに違いない。 (The lights next door have been off for days. The family must have gone on a trip.) | こんなに人が並んでいるんだから、この店のラーメンはおいしいに違いない。 (With this many people in line, the ramen here must be good.) | この手紙の字は、父の字に違いない。 (The handwriting on this letter is surely my father's.) [Ghi chú: Strong conviction based on evidence or intuition; a slightly written tone. Compare 〜に決まっている, which is more subjective and conversational.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: certainly; is bound to; of course
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に決まっている
Ví dụ minh họa: 練習もしないで試合に出たら、負けるに決まっている。 (If you play the match without practicing, you're bound to lose.) | 一人で富士山に登るなんて、お母さんが心配するに決まってるでしょう。 (Climbing Mt. Fuji alone? Of course your mother's going to worry.) | そんなうまい話、うそに決まっているよ。 (A deal that good? It's got to be a lie.) [Ghi chú: A very confident, subjective judgment, common in conversation (〜に決まってる). More assertive than 〜に違いない and not suited to formal writing.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: have a feeling that; feel like
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + 気がする / Verb-plain / Noun + の + ような + 気がする
Ví dụ minh họa: この人とは、どこかで会ったことがある気がする。 (I feel like I've met this person somewhere before.) | 今日は何か、いいことがありそうな気がする。 (I have a feeling something good is going to happen today.) | ドアの鍵をかけ忘れたような気がして、家に戻った。 (I had a feeling I'd forgotten to lock the door, so I went back home.) [Ghi chú: A vague, intuitive impression rather than a firm judgment; ような気がする is even softer. Different from N4 〜がする (a smell, sound or taste).]

けさは朝ご飯を食べずに家を出た。 (This morning I left home without eating breakfast.) | 辞書を使わずに、この新聞記事が読めますか。 (Can you read this newspaper article without using a dictionary?) | 彼は誰にも相談せずに、会社を辞めてしまった。 (He quit the company without consulting anyone.) [Ghi chú: More formal, written-style equivalent of 〜ないで. Irregular: する → せずに (not しずに), 来る → 来ずに (こずに).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: as it is; unchanged; while still (in a state)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-ta / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + まま
Ví dụ minh họa: エアコンをつけたまま寝てしまい、風邪をひいた。 (I fell asleep with the air conditioner on and caught a cold.) | この町は、私が子どもだったころのままだ。 (This town is just as it was when I was a child.) | 靴のまま部屋に入らないでください。 (Please don't come into the room with your shoes on.) [Ghi chú: An expected change hasn't happened and the state continues. Often suggests something unusual or undesirable (leaving the lights on, shoes on indoors).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: while (before it changes); before it's too late; in the course of
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + うちに
Ví dụ minh họa: 若いうちに、いろいろな国を旅行したほうがいい。 (You should travel to lots of countries while you're young.) | スープが冷めないうちに、どうぞ召し上がってください。 (Please have your soup before it gets cold.) | 音楽を聞いているうちに、いつの間にか眠ってしまった。 (While I was listening to music, I fell asleep before I knew it.) [Ghi chú: Do something while a condition lasts, before it changes; or a change that happens unnoticed during an activity. Compare 〜間に, which marks a fixed period without that urgency.]

Từ / Mẫu câu / Hán tự: 〜ところに / 〜ところへ / 〜ところを
Cách đọc (Furigana / On-Kun): tokoro ni / tokoro e / tokoro o
Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: just when; at the moment (someone arrives or something interrupts)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-ta + ところに / ところへ / ところを
Ví dụ minh họa: 出かけようとしているところに、友達から電話がかかってきた。 (Just as I was about to go out, a friend called.) | みんなで君の話をしているところへ、ちょうど君が来た。 (Just as we were all talking about you, you showed up.) | 授業中にスマホを見ているところを、先生に見られてしまった。 (The teacher caught me looking at my phone during class.) [Ghi chú: ところに/へ: something happens or someone arrives at that moment, often interrupting. ところを: the scene is the object of a verb like 見る, 見つかる, 助ける. Set phrase: お忙しいところを.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-ba + Verb-dict + ほど / i-Adj stem + ければ + i-Adj + ほど / na-Adj + なら + na-Adj + な + ほど
Ví dụ minh họa: 日本語は、勉強すればするほど面白くなる。 (The more you study Japanese, the more interesting it gets.) | スマホの画面は大きければ大きいほど見やすいが、持ち歩くのは大変だ。 (The bigger a phone screen, the easier it is to see, but it's a pain to carry around.) | 部屋が静かなら静かなほど、よく眠れる。 (The quieter the room, the better I sleep.) [Ghi chú: The same word is repeated, first in the ば/なら form, then in plain form. The first part can be dropped: 考えるほど分からなくなる.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: to the extent that; so ... that
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ほど
Ví dụ minh họa: 昨日は、立っていられないほど疲れていた。 (Yesterday I was so tired I could hardly stand.) | 試験に合格したと聞いて、涙が出るほどうれしかった。 (When I heard I'd passed the exam, I was so happy I cried.) | このあたりは、夜になると怖いほど静かだ。 (At night this area gets so quiet it's scary.) [Ghi chú: Shows degree with an example or comparison. Often interchangeable with 〜くらい, but ほど sounds more formal and suits high degrees; it can't mark something as minimal.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: to the extent that; so ... that; at least (something minimal)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + くらい
Ví dụ minh họa: おなかが痛くて、歩けないくらいだった。 (My stomach hurt so much I could barely walk.) | 隣の部屋の音楽がうるさくて、自分の声も聞こえないぐらいだ。 (The music next door is so loud I can't even hear my own voice.) | 自分の部屋ぐらい、自分で掃除しなさい。 (At least clean your own room yourself.) [Ghi chú: Like 〜ほど, shows degree. くらい can also mark something as small or easy ('at least; such a simple thing as'), a use ほど doesn't have.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + さえ / Noun + でさえ / Noun + にさえ
Ví dụ minh họa: 忙しくて、昼ご飯を食べる時間さえなかった。 (I was so busy I didn't even have time to eat lunch.) | こんな簡単な問題は、小学生でさえ解ける。 (Even an elementary school student could solve such an easy problem.) | 彼女は親友にさえ本当のことを話さなかった。 (She didn't tell the truth even to her best friend.) [Ghi chú: Gives an extreme example, implying 'so naturally the others too'. More formal than 〜も or 〜でも in this sense. As a subject: 〜でさえ. Compare N1 〜すら.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: if only; as long as; provided that
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + さえ + Verb-ba / Verb-stem + さえ + すれば / Verb-te + さえ + いれば
Ví dụ minh họa: このアプリさえあれば、どこでも日本語の勉強ができる。 (As long as you have this app, you can study Japanese anywhere.) | 時間さえあれば、もっと旅行に行きたいんですが。 (If only I had the time, I'd love to travel more.) | 薬を飲んで寝てさえいれば、すぐに治りますよ。 (As long as you take your medicine and stay in bed, you'll be better in no time.) [Ghi chú: Stresses that this one condition is enough by itself, or is the only thing missing.]

「いつもありがとう。」「いえ、こちらこそ。」 ('Thanks for everything.' 'No, thank you!') | 今年こそ、たばこをやめるつもりだ。 (This year, for sure, I'm going to quit smoking.) | 毎日の小さな努力こそが、大きな成功につながる。 (It's precisely small daily efforts that lead to great success.) [Ghi chú: Singles out one thing as the very one that matters. こちらこそ is a set reply: 'the thanks/pleasure is mine'. Related N2 forms: 〜からこそ, 〜てこそ.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: as; in the role or capacity of
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + として / Noun + としての + Noun
Ví dụ minh họa: 兄は、エンジニアとしてアメリカの会社で働いている。 (My older brother works as an engineer at an American company.) | この町は、温泉地として有名です。 (This town is famous as a hot-spring resort.) | 社会人としての責任を持って行動してください。 (Please act with the responsibility expected of a working adult.) [Ghi chú: States a role, status or category. Compare 〜にとって, which states from whose point of view a judgment is made.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + にとって / Noun + にとっての + Noun
Ví dụ minh họa: 私にとって、家族は何よりも大切なものです。 (To me, family is more important than anything.) | このあたりの坂道は、お年寄りにとってはかなり大変だ。 (The slopes around here are quite tough for elderly people.) | 留学は、彼にとっていい経験になったようだ。 (Studying abroad seems to have been a good experience for him.) [Ghi chú: Followed by an evaluation (大切だ, 難しい, 便利だ). Not for actions or attitudes toward someone; use 〜に対して for those.]

初めて作ったにしては、このケーキはよくできている。 (For a first attempt, this cake turned out really well.) | 彼は小学生にしては、ずいぶん難しい言葉を知っている。 (For an elementary school kid, he knows some pretty difficult words.) | 十月にしては、今日はずいぶん暑いね。 (It's pretty hot today for October.) [Ghi chú: The result is different from what you'd expect of X. Doesn't follow adjectives; compare 〜わりに, which can and focuses on degree (price, age, effort).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: even if; even considering; granted that
Ví dụ minh họa: 忙しかったにしても、電話一本ぐらいできたでしょう。 (Even if you were busy, you could at least have made one phone call.) | 冗談にしても、そんな言い方はひどいよ。 (Even if it was a joke, that was a terrible thing to say.) | 引っ越すにしても、来年の春以降になると思います。 (Even if we do move, I think it'll be after next spring.) [Ghi chú: Accepts a point, then says it doesn't change the speaker's view. Often accepts a fact; compare 〜としても, which is more purely hypothetical.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + に関して / Noun + に関する + Noun
Ví dụ minh họa: 新しいサービスに関してご質問がある方は、受付までどうぞ。 (Anyone with questions regarding the new service, please come to the reception desk.) | 彼は日本の歴史に関する本をたくさん持っている。 (He owns a lot of books on Japanese history.) | 事故の原因に関しては、現在調査中です。 (The cause of the accident is currently under investigation.) [Ghi chú: More formal than 〜について; common in business, news and writing. Before a noun, use に関する (or に関しての).]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + に比べて / Verb-dict + のに比べて
Ví dụ minh họa: 今年の夏は、去年に比べてずいぶん涼しい。 (This summer is much cooler compared to last year.) | 都会に比べて、田舎は家賃が安い。 (Compared to the city, rent in the countryside is cheap.) | 電車で行くのに比べて、車で行くと三十分ほど長くかかる。 (Compared to going by train, driving takes about thirty minutes longer.) [Ghi chú: Also 〜と比べて, 〜に比べると and 〜に比べれば. Sets two things side by side more explicitly than 〜より.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: instead of; on behalf of; replacing
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + に代わって / Noun + に代わり
Ví dụ minh họa: 入院中の社長に代わって、副社長があいさつをした。 (The vice president gave the speech on behalf of the president, who is in hospital.) | 最近は、紙の新聞に代わって、スマホでニュースを読む人が増えている。 (More and more people these days read the news on their phones instead of in paper newspapers.) | 父に代わって、私が町内会の会議に出席しました。 (I attended the neighborhood association meeting in place of my father.) [Ghi chú: Someone acts for another person, or something new replaces something old. Written form: 〜に代わり. Compare 〜代わりに (instead of doing; in exchange for).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: instead of; in exchange for; to make up for
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + 代わりに
Ví dụ minh họa: 今日は外で食べる代わりに、家でカレーを作った。 (Instead of eating out today, I made curry at home.) | 友達に英語を教える代わりに、ギターを教えてもらっている。 (In exchange for teaching my friend English, I'm getting guitar lessons.) | このアパートは駅から遠い代わりに、家賃が安い。 (This apartment is far from the station, but to make up for it, the rent is cheap.) [Ghi chú: Three uses: substitution (instead of), exchange (in return for), and compensation (a downside balanced by an upside).]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + に従って / Verb-dict + に従って
Ví dụ minh họa: 係の人の指示に従って、落ち着いて避難してください。 (Please evacuate calmly, following the staff's instructions.) | 高く登るに従って、気温が下がっていった。 (The higher we climbed, the lower the temperature dropped.) | 町が大きくなるに従って、交通の問題も増えてきた。 (As the town grew, traffic problems increased too.) [Ghi chú: With nouns such as rules or instructions: 'following, obeying'. With Verb-dict: proportional change like 〜につれて, in a more formal tone.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: as (one thing changes, another changes too)
Ví dụ minh họa: 年をとるにつれて、朝早く目が覚めるようになった。 (As I've gotten older, I've started waking up early in the morning.) | 日本での生活に慣れるにつれて、友達も増えていった。 (As I got used to life in Japan, I made more and more friends.) | 時間がたつにつれて、その事故のことは忘れられていった。 (As time passed, the accident was gradually forgotten.) [Ghi chú: Both halves describe gradual change. The main clause can't be a request or the speaker's intention. Close to 〜に従って and 〜とともに.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: together with; along with; as; at the same time as
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + とともに / Verb-dict + とともに
Ví dụ minh họa: 社長は、社員とともに新しい工場の完成を喜んだ。 (The company president celebrated the completion of the new factory together with the staff.) | 経済の発展とともに、人々の生活も大きく変わった。 (Along with economic development, people's lives changed greatly too.) | ベルが鳴るとともに、学生たちは教室を飛び出した。 (The moment the bell rang, the students rushed out of the classroom.) [Ghi chú: Formal version of 〜と一緒に. Also marks events happening at the same moment, or proportional change like 〜につれて.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Noun + の + たびに
Ví dụ minh họa: この写真を見るたびに、大学時代を思い出す。 (Every time I look at this photo, I remember my university days.) | 姉は出張のたびに、お土産を買ってきてくれる。 (My older sister brings me a souvenir every time she goes on a business trip.) | この川は、大雨が降るたびにあふれて、道が通れなくなる。 (Every time there's heavy rain, this river overflows and the road becomes impassable.) [Ghi chú: Each time A happens, B happens too. More emphatic than 〜と or 〜ときはいつも.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + ごとに / Verb-dict + ごとに
Ví dụ minh họa: このバスは十五分ごとに出ています。 (This bus leaves every fifteen minutes.) | 季節ごとに、店の飾りが変わる。 (The shop's decorations change with each season.) | 一回使うごとにポイントがたまるカードです。 (It's a card that earns you points every time you use it.) [Ghi chú: Regular repetition, or each unit in turn. With Verb-dict it's close to 〜たびに. Careful: 一日ごとに = every day, but 一日おきに (N4) = every other day.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: right in the middle of; while (busy with)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-te + いる / Noun + の + 最中に
Ví dụ minh họa: 大事な会議の最中に、携帯電話が鳴ってしまった。 (My cell phone went off right in the middle of an important meeting.) | 料理をしている最中に、停電になった。 (The power went out right in the middle of my cooking.) | 今、試験の最中だから、廊下では静かにしてください。 (An exam is in progress right now, so please be quiet in the hallway.) [Ghi chú: Stresses the height of an activity, usually when something unexpected interrupts it. Stronger than 〜中に or 〜ている間に. Also 〜最中だ.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: while (at it); on the occasion of; since one is doing it anyway
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + ついでに
Ví dụ minh họa: 郵便局へ行くついでに、この手紙も出してきてくれる？ (Since you're going to the post office, could you mail this letter too?) | 京都へ出張したついでに、昔の友達に会ってきた。 (While I was on a business trip to Kyoto, I took the chance to see an old friend.) | 買い物のついでに、図書館に本を返した。 (I returned some books to the library while I was out shopping.) [Ghi chú: The main action happens anyway; the second is added because it's convenient. Compare N1 〜がてら.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + おかげで
Ví dụ minh họa: 先輩が手伝ってくれたおかげで、仕事が早く終わった。 (Thanks to my senior colleague's help, the work was finished early.) | 薬が効いたおかげで、熱が下がった。 (Thanks to the medicine, my fever went down.) | 駅が近いおかげで、雨の日も楽に通勤できる。 (Because the station is close by, commuting is easy even on rainy days.) [Ghi chú: Cause of a good result, with a feeling of gratitude. Sometimes used sarcastically for a bad result (君のおかげで遅刻したよ). Compare 〜せいで (blame).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: because of; due to (bad result, blame)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + せいで
Ví dụ minh họa: 電車が遅れたせいで、面接に遅刻してしまった。 (Because the train was delayed, I was late for my interview.) | 夜中に犬がうるさかったせいで、ほとんど眠れなかった。 (Because the dog was so noisy in the middle of the night, I could barely sleep.) | 私が道を間違えたせいで、みんなを待たせてしまった。 (Because I took a wrong turn, I kept everyone waiting.) [Ghi chú: Cause of a bad result, placing blame. 〜のせいにする = 'blame something on'. The opposite feeling of 〜おかげで.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: the moment; just as (something unexpected happens)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-ta + とたん / とたんに
Ví dụ minh họa: 立ち上がったとたんに、めまいがした。 (The moment I stood up, I felt dizzy.) | 家を出たとたん、雨が降り出した。 (Just as I stepped out of the house, it started to rain.) | その歌手がステージに現れたとたん、会場から大きな拍手が起こった。 (The moment the singer appeared on stage, the audience burst into applause.) [Ghi chú: The second event is sudden and outside the speaker's control. Not used for the speaker's own planned actions, requests or intentions.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: when I did A, (I found that) B; upon doing, I discovered
Ví dụ minh họa: 窓を開けたら、外は一面の雪だった。 (When I opened the window, everything outside was covered in snow.) | 久しぶりに実家に帰ったら、近所に大きなマンションが建っていた。 (When I went back to my parents' place for the first time in ages, I found a big apartment building had gone up nearby.) | かばんの中を探してみたら、なくしたと思っていた鍵が出てきた。 (When I searched my bag, the key I thought I'd lost turned up.) [Ghi chú: After an action, the speaker notices or discovers something. The second clause is past and outside the speaker's control. 〜と〜た is a more written equivalent.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-ta + って / i-Adj-ku + たって / na-Adj / Noun + だって
Ví dụ minh họa: 今から急いだって、もう間に合わないよ。 (Even if you hurry now, you won't make it.) | 高くたって、欲しいものは欲しい。 (Even if it's expensive, I want what I want.) | いくら便利だって、使い方が分からなければ意味がない。 (No matter how convenient it is, it's pointless if you don't know how to use it.) [Ghi chú: Colloquial form of 〜ても / 〜でも, often with いくら or question words. だって also means 'because' at the start of a sentence, and 'even' after nouns.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: it's not that ... not; can if necessary; not impossible
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない + ことはない
Ví dụ minh họa: 辛い料理は食べられないことはないけど、あまり好きじゃない。 (It's not that I can't eat spicy food, but I don't really like it.) | 今から急げば、間に合わないことはないと思う。 (If we hurry now, I think we can just about make it.) | この服、少し派手だけど、似合わないことはないよ。 (This outfit is a bit flashy, but it's not as if it doesn't suit you.) [Ghi chú: A double negative giving a hesitant 'yes'. Also 〜ないこともない. Don't confuse with Verb-dict + ことはない ('there's no need to').]

Từ / Mẫu câu / Hán tự: 〜てしょうがない / 〜てしかたがない
Cách đọc (Furigana / On-Kun): te shou ga nai / te shikata ga nai
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + しょうがない / しかたがない
Ví dụ minh họa: 昨日あまり寝ていないので、眠くてしょうがない。 (I barely slept last night, so I'm terribly sleepy.) | 来週の旅行が楽しみでしかたがない。 (I'm so excited about next week's trip I can hardly wait.) | 一人暮らしを始めたばかりのころは、家族のことが気になってしかたがなかった。 (When I'd just started living alone, I couldn't stop worrying about my family.) [Ghi chú: For feelings and sensations the speaker can't control. しょうがない is more casual. Unlike 〜てたまらない, it also works with spontaneous verbs like 気になる or 涙が出る.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-te / i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で + たまらない
Ví dụ minh họa: この部屋はエアコンがなくて、暑くてたまらない。 (This room has no air conditioning; it's unbearably hot.) | 三年ぶりに国の家族に会えるので、うれしくてたまらない。 (I'm going to see my family back home for the first time in three years, and I'm overjoyed.) | 試合に負けたのが悔しくてたまらなかった。 (I was terribly frustrated that we lost the match.) [Ghi chú: Strong, direct feelings or bodily sensations; very common with desire (〜たくてたまらない). Not used for objective facts. Compare 〜てしかたがない.]

病気になってはじめて、健康のありがたさが分かった。 (It was only after I got sick that I appreciated how precious good health is.) | 一人で暮らしてはじめて、親の苦労が分かった。 (Only after living alone did I understand how hard my parents had worked.) | 実際に使ってみてはじめて、この機械の便利さに気づいた。 (It wasn't until I actually tried it that I realized how handy this machine is.) [Ghi chú: Something is realized or becomes possible only after an experience; often followed by 分かる, 気づく or 知る. Also written 〜て初めて.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: do nothing but; keep on doing (critical)
Ví dụ minh họa: 弟は休みの日、ゲームをしてばかりいる。 (On his days off, my younger brother does nothing but play games.) | 泣いてばかりいないで、どうしたのか話してごらん。 (Stop crying and tell me what happened.) | 休みの間、寝てばかりいたら、かえって疲れてしまった。 (I did nothing but sleep during the break, and it actually made me more tired.) [Ghi chú: A repeated or constant action, usually with criticism or dissatisfaction. Compare N4 Noun + ばかり (甘い物ばかり食べる).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: should; all you need to do is; I hope (with のに/けど: I wish)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-ba + いい / i-Adj stem + ければ + いい
Ví dụ minh họa: 「この書類、どこに出せばいいですか。」「二階の受付に出してください。」 ('Where should I hand in this form?' 'Please take it to the reception desk on the second floor.') | 分からないことがあったら、遠慮しないで私に聞けばいいよ。 (If there's anything you don't understand, just ask me. Don't be shy.) | 明日、雨が降らなければいいんだけど。 (I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.) [Ghi chú: Asks for or gives advice (〜ばいいですか = 'what should I do?'). 〜ばいいのに = 'I wish'. 〜たらいい is a near-synonym; 〜ほうがいい sounds more insistent.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: in the case of; if; in the event that
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + 場合（は）
Ví dụ minh họa: 雨の場合は、試合は中止になります。 (In case of rain, the game will be canceled.) | カードをなくした場合は、すぐに銀行に連絡してください。 (If you lose your card, contact the bank immediately.) | 予約の時間に遅れる場合は、お電話でお知らせください。 (If you are going to be late for your appointment, please let us know by phone.) [Ghi chú: Typical of instructions, rules and announcements about possible situations. Unlike 〜たら, it is not used to narrate a one-off past event.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + とすれば / としたら
Ví dụ minh họa: もし宝くじで一億円当たったとしたら、何に使いますか。 (If you won 100 million yen in the lottery, what would you spend it on?) | 今から出発するとすれば、向こうに着くのは夜の九時ごろになる。 (If we set off now, we'll get there at around nine at night.) | 彼の話が本当だとしたら、大変なことになる。 (If what he says is true, we're in serious trouble.) [Ghi chú: Sets up a hypothesis and considers what follows. Often with もし or 仮に. としたら is more conversational; とすれば sounds more like logical reasoning.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + としても
Ví dụ minh họa: 親に反対されたとしても、私は留学するつもりだ。 (Even if my parents are against it, I intend to study abroad.) | 今からタクシーに乗ったとしても、九時の飛行機には間に合わないだろう。 (Even if we took a taxi now, we probably wouldn't make the nine o'clock flight.) | それが本当だとしても、ほかの人に話すべきではない。 (Even if that's true, you shouldn't tell anyone else.) [Ghi chú: Hypothetical concession: even assuming A, B still holds. More hypothetical than 〜ても; compare 〜にしても, which often accepts a fact.]

駅前の本屋、今月で閉店するとか。寂しくなりますね。 (I hear the bookstore by the station is closing at the end of this month. It'll be sad to see it go.) | 今年の冬は、例年より寒くなるとかいう話だよ。 (Word is that this winter is going to be colder than usual.) | 部長は今日、熱があるとかで休んでいます。 (The department manager is off today; something about having a fever.) [Ghi chú: Vague hearsay; softer and less certain than 〜そうだ. Often 〜とかいう話だ, 〜とか聞いた, or 〜とかで (giving a reported reason). Different from listing 〜とか〜とか.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: (casual quotation) says that; I heard; as for; what is
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Sentence + って / Noun + って
Ví dụ minh họa: 彼女、今日は来られないって。 (She says she can't come today.) | 駅前に新しいカフェができたんだって。行ってみない？ (Apparently a new café opened by the station. Want to go check it out?) | 「ふろしき」って何ですか。 (What's a furoshiki?) [Ghi chú: Casual stand-in for と (quoting), そうだ (hearsay, often 〜んだって) and は (topic, especially 'what is X?'). Common in speech; avoided in formal writing.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: I heard that; it means that; in other words
Ví dụ minh họa: 駅員さんの話では、事故のため電車は一時間ほど止まるということです。 (According to the station attendant, trains will be stopped for about an hour because of an accident.) | 「申し込みは明日までです。」「じゃあ、今日中に書類を準備しなければならないということですね。」 ('Applications close tomorrow.' 'So that means I have to get my documents ready today, right?') | 全員が賛成したということは、この計画で進めてもいいということだ。 (Everyone agreeing means we can go ahead with this plan.) [Ghi chú: Two uses: reporting information (more formal than 〜そうだ) and drawing a conclusion ('so that means ...'). The conclusion use often ends in ということですね.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: what is meant by ... is; ... means; the reason is
Ví dụ minh họa: 「割り勘」というのは、食事代などをみんなで同じ金額ずつ払うことです。 ('Warikan' means everyone paying the same share of a meal or other bill.) | 一人で海外に住むというのは、思ったより大変なことだ。 (Living abroad on your own is harder than you'd think.) | 来週の旅行には行けなくなった。というのは、急に出張が入ったからだ。 (I can't go on next week's trip after all. That's because a business trip suddenly came up.) [Ghi chú: Introduces a word to define or a situation to comment on. Casual: 〜って. At the start of a sentence, というのは introduces a reason ending in 〜からだ. Written: 〜とは.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: rather than; not so much A as B
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というより
Ví dụ minh họa: 今日は涼しいというより、寒いくらいだ。 (Today it's not so much cool as almost cold.) | 彼女は友達というより、家族のような存在だ。 (She's less a friend than something like family to me.) | それは意見というより、ただの文句だよ。 (That's not so much an opinion as just a complaint.) [Ghi chú: Corrects or refines a description: the second one fits better. Often followed by むしろ.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わりに
Ví dụ minh họa: この店は値段のわりに、量が多くておいしい。 (For the price, this restaurant gives you big, tasty portions.) | 兄はよく食べるわりには、全然太らない。 (Considering how much he eats, my older brother never gains weight.) | このホテルは駅から近いわりに、静かでよく眠れた。 (Considering how close it is to the station, the hotel was quiet and I slept well.) [Ghi chú: The result doesn't match the degree you'd expect from A (price, age, effort). Can follow adjectives, unlike 〜にしては.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + くせに
Ví dụ minh họa: 自分では何もしないくせに、人の仕事には文句ばかり言う。 (He never does anything himself, yet he's always complaining about other people's work.) | 知っているくせに、どうして教えてくれなかったの？ (You knew all along, so why didn't you tell me?) | 弟は体が大きいくせに、小さな虫をこわがる。 (My younger brother is so big, and yet he's scared of tiny bugs.) [Ghi chú: Like 〜のに, but with contempt or reproach toward the subject. Both clauses share the same subject; rarely used about oneself. Casual.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: from ... through; over (a period or area)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + から + Noun + にかけて
Ví dụ minh họa: 今夜から明日の朝にかけて、強い雨が降るでしょう。 (Heavy rain is expected from tonight through tomorrow morning.) | 関東から東北にかけての広い地域で、強い揺れが観測された。 (Strong shaking was recorded over a wide area from Kanto to Tohoku.) | この花は、三月から四月にかけてきれいに咲く。 (This flower blooms beautifully from March through April.) [Ghi chú: A rough span of time or space whose edges aren't exact; common in weather reports. Compare 〜から〜まで, which marks clear start and end points.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: for the first time in (a period); manner, way of doing
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + ぶり / Verb-stem + ぶり
Ví dụ minh họa: 五年ぶりに高校の友達に会って、話が止まらなかった。 (I saw my high school friends for the first time in five years, and we couldn't stop talking.) | 久しぶりですね。お元気でしたか。 (It's been a long time. How have you been?) | 新入社員の仕事ぶりを見て、部長は安心したようだ。 (The manager seemed relieved after seeing how the new employee works.) [Ghi chú: Time span + ぶり: the first time in that long (〜ぶりに / 〜ぶりの). Noun or Verb-stem + ぶり: the way someone does something (仕事ぶり, 話しぶり).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: was it?; did I?; (trying to recall)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-ta / Noun + だ / Noun + だった + っけ
Ví dụ minh họa: あれ、会議って何時からだっけ？ (Wait, what time does the meeting start again?) | すみません、お名前、何とおっしゃいましたっけ。 (I'm sorry, what did you say your name was?) | 子どものころ、よくこの公園で遊んだっけ。 (I used to play in this park a lot as a kid, didn't I.) [Ghi chú: Checks something you've forgotten, or recalls the past fondly (〜たっけ). Polite forms: 〜でしたっけ, 〜ましたっけ.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-stem + ますように / Verb-stem + ませんように
Ví dụ minh họa: 試験に合格できますように。 (I hope I pass the exam.) | 明日の遠足、雨が降りませんように。 (Please don't let it rain on tomorrow's school outing.) | 家族みんなが元気で過ごせますように。 (May everyone in my family stay healthy.) [Ghi chú: Used for wishes and prayers, e.g. at a shrine or on tanabata strips, and at the end of letters wishing someone well.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + ふりをする
Ví dụ minh họa: 母に呼ばれたが、聞こえないふりをしてゲームを続けた。 (My mother called me, but I pretended not to hear and kept playing my game.) | 彼は本当は知っているのに、知らないふりをしている。 (He actually knows, but he's pretending not to.) | 電車の中で、寝たふりをして席を譲らない人がいる。 (Some people on the train pretend to be asleep so they don't have to give up their seats.) [Ghi chú: Deliberately giving a false impression. Verb-ta is common: 寝たふり, 死んだふり.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: suitable for / aimed at; intended for
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + 向き / Noun + 向け
Ví dụ minh họa: この料理は作り方が簡単なので、初心者向きだ。 (This dish is easy to make, so it's well suited to beginners.) | この雑誌は、若い女性向けに作られている。 (This magazine is made for young women.) | 子ども向けの番組だが、大人が見ても十分楽しめる。 (It's a program aimed at children, but adults can enjoy it too.) [Ghi chú: 向き: happens to suit X well. 向け: made on purpose for X. 向き also means 'facing' (南向きの部屋).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: tend to; be prone to; often
Ví dụ minh họa: 冬になると、つい家にこもりがちになる。 (When winter comes, I tend to stay cooped up at home.) | 娘は小さいころ病気がちだったが、今はとても元気だ。 (My daughter was often sick when she was little, but now she's very healthy.) | 一人暮らしだと、野菜が不足しがちです。 (When you live alone, you tend not to get enough vegetables.) [Ghi chú: A frequent tendency toward something undesirable. Compare 〜やすい (easily happens, can be neutral) and 〜気味 (a slight sign of a condition now).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: a touch of; slightly; somewhat (in that condition)
Ví dụ minh họa: 少し風邪気味なので、今日は早めに帰ります。 (I have a bit of a cold, so I'll head home early today.) | 最近、仕事が忙しくて疲れ気味だ。 (Work has been busy lately, and I'm feeling a little worn out.) | 人手が足りず、工事は予定より遅れ気味だ。 (They're short-handed, so the construction is running a little behind schedule.) [Ghi chú: A slight sign of a (usually negative) condition at present. Compare 〜がち, which means something happens often.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: full of; covered with; riddled with
Ví dụ minh họa: 子どもたちは、泥だらけになって帰ってきた。 (The children came home covered in mud.) | 急いで書いたレポートは、間違いだらけだった。 (The report I wrote in a hurry was full of mistakes.) | 引っ越したばかりで、部屋はまだ段ボールだらけだ。 (I've just moved, so my place is still full of cardboard boxes.) [Ghi chú: An unpleasantly large amount of something covering or filling a place; usually negative. Compare N1 〜まみれ (covered in something sticky or dirty).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: do completely; finish / can't finish; too many to
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-stem + 切る / Verb-stem + 切れない
Ví dụ minh họa: 三時間かけて、長い小説を最後まで読み切った。 (It took three hours, but I read the long novel right to the end.) | 注文しすぎて、料理を食べ切れなかった。 (We ordered too much and couldn't finish all the food.) | 山の上では、数え切れないほどの星が見えた。 (From the mountaintop we could see more stars than we could count.) [Ghi chú: Doing something through to the very end. Also describes a total state: 疲れ切る ('be utterly exhausted'). Often written in kana: 〜きる / 〜きれない.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: half-done; start to; be about to
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-stem + かける / Verb-stem + かけの + Noun
Ví dụ minh họa: 読みかけの本が、机の上に置いてある。 (There's a half-read book on the desk.) | 彼女は何か言いかけたが、そのまま黙ってしまった。 (She started to say something, but then fell silent.) | この花は枯れかけていたが、水をやったら元気になった。 (This flower was starting to wilt, but it perked up after I watered it.) [Ghi chú: An action has started but isn't finished, or something is on the verge of happening (死にかける). Verb-stem + かけの + noun describes the half-finished thing.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: do to each other; do together
Ví dụ minh họa: 困ったときは、お互いに助け合いましょう。 (Let's help each other out when things get tough.) | 旅行の計画について、家族で話し合った。 (We talked over the travel plans as a family.) | 優勝が決まると、選手たちは抱き合って喜んだ。 (When their victory was confirmed, the players hugged each other in joy.) [Ghi chú: Reciprocal or shared action. Many compounds are set words: 話し合う, 知り合う, 付き合う, 助け合う.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: redo; do over again (to fix or improve)
Ví dụ minh họa: 名前を間違えたので、書類を書き直した。 (I got the name wrong, so I rewrote the document.) | すみません、電波が悪いので、あとでかけ直します。 (Sorry, the signal's bad, so I'll call you back later.) | 一度はあきらめた夢だが、もう一度考え直してみることにした。 (It's a dream I once gave up on, but I've decided to reconsider it.) [Ghi chú: Doing something again in order to correct or improve it. Plain repetition (もう一度〜する) doesn't carry that sense of fixing.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: hard to; difficult or uncomfortable to
Ví dụ minh họa: この靴は少し小さくて、歩きづらい。 (These shoes are a bit small, so they're hard to walk in.) | 先輩にお金を貸してほしいとは、ちょっと言いづらい。 (It's a bit awkward to ask a senior colleague to lend me money.) | 字が小さくて読みづらいので、もう少し大きくしてもらえますか。 (The text is too small to read comfortably. Could you make it a bit bigger?) [Ghi chú: Stresses the doer's physical or psychological discomfort. 〜にくい (N4) is more objective, describing a thing's nature. Formal N2: 〜がたい.]

Cách đọc (Furigana / On-Kun): beki da / beki de wa nai
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict + べきだ / Verb-dict + べきではない
Ví dụ minh họa: 自分が悪いと思ったら、すぐに謝るべきだ。 (If you think you were in the wrong, you should apologize right away.) | 環境のために、私たちはもっとエネルギーを大切に使うべきだ。 (For the sake of the environment, we should use energy more carefully.) | 病院の中では、大きな声で話すべきではない。 (You shouldn't talk loudly inside a hospital.) [Ghi chú: A strong opinion about what is right or one's duty; too blunt to use toward superiors. する → すべき or するべき. Compare 〜ほうがいい (advice) and 〜ものだ (social norm).]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: nothing is as ... as; there's no ... like
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + ほど + i-Adj / na-Adj + な + Noun + はない
Ví dụ minh họa: 仕事の後に飲む冷たいビールほどおいしいものはない。 (Nothing tastes as good as an ice-cold beer after work.) | この町で、あの店ほど安くておいしいラーメン屋はない。 (There's no ramen shop in this town as cheap and tasty as that one.) | 健康ほど大切なものはないと、病気になって気づいた。 (When I got sick, I realized that nothing is as important as good health.) [Ghi chú: Says X is the most ... of all, usually from personal experience or feeling. Also 〜くらい〜はない.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: have no choice but to; can only
Ví dụ minh họa: 終電に乗り遅れたから、タクシーで帰るしかない。 (I missed the last train, so I have no choice but to take a taxi home.) | 誰も手伝ってくれないなら、一人でやるしかない。 (If nobody will help me, I'll just have to do it myself.) | ここまで来たら、もう最後まで頑張るしかないね。 (Now that we've come this far, all we can do is give it our all to the end.) [Ghi chú: No other option exists, so the speaker accepts this one. Differs from Noun + しか〜ない ('only'). Formal N2 equivalent: 〜ほかない.]

Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + まで / Noun + にまで
Ví dụ minh họa: 最近は、小学生までスマホを持っている。 (These days even elementary school kids have smartphones.) | 親友にまでうそをつかれて、とてもショックだった。 (I was really shocked that even my best friend lied to me.) | 雨だけでなく、風まで強くなってきた。 (It's not just the rain; now even the wind is getting stronger.) [Ghi chú: Adds an extreme item on top of others, often with surprise or dismay. Compare 〜さえ, which picks out one extreme example on its own.]

考え事をしていて、もう少しで車にひかれるところだった。 (I was lost in thought and nearly got hit by a car.) | 目覚ましが鳴らなくて、危うく飛行機に乗り遅れるところだった。 (My alarm didn't go off, and I very nearly missed my flight.) | 君が教えてくれなかったら、大事な書類を出し忘れるところだったよ。 (If you hadn't reminded me, I would have forgotten to hand in the important documents.) [Ghi chú: Something (usually bad) came very close to happening but didn't. Often with もう少しで, 危うく or a 〜たら clause. Compare 〜そうになった.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: just because (... doesn't mean); simply because
Ví dụ minh họa: 日本人だからといって、みんなが敬語を正しく使えるわけではない。 (Just because someone is Japanese doesn't mean they can use keigo correctly.) | 忙しいからといって、朝ご飯を食べないのは体によくない。 (Skipping breakfast just because you're busy isn't good for you.) | 一回負けたからといって、あきらめる必要はない。 (There's no need to give up just because you lost once.) [Ghi chú: Denies that a reason automatically leads to a conclusion. Usually followed by a negative such as 〜わけではない or 〜とは限らない. Casual: 〜からって.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: as; in the way that; exactly as
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + とおりに / Noun + どおりに
Ví dụ minh họa: 説明書に書いてあるとおりに組み立てたのに、うまく動かない。 (I put it together exactly as the manual says, but it doesn't work properly.) | 先生が言ったとおり、試験には去年と似た問題が出た。 (Just as the teacher said, questions similar to last year's came up on the exam.) | 工事は予定どおりに進んでいる。 (The construction is going according to schedule.) [Ghi chú: Doing something exactly like a model, instruction or prediction. Directly after a noun it becomes どおり (予定どおり, 思いどおり). に is often dropped. そのとおりだ = 'exactly'.]

Ý nghĩa / Giải thích: things like; the likes of (dismissive or humble); how ...! (surprise)
Công thức / Cấu trúc: Noun + なんか / Noun + なんて / Sentence + なんて
Ví dụ minh họa: 私なんか、まだまだ初心者です。 (Someone like me is still just a beginner.) | 幽霊なんて、いるわけがないよ。 (Ghosts? There's no way they exist.) | あの二人が結婚するなんて、びっくりした。 (Those two are getting married? I was so surprised!) [Ghi chú: Casual version of など with a dismissive, humble or surprised tone. なんか also softens suggestions (お茶なんかどう？). Sentence + なんて shows surprise or disbelief.]
